name: jira
description: Atlassian Jira MCP integration for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Search and manage Jira issues from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Atlassian Jira through the official Atlassian remote MCP server. Each user authenticates with their own Atlassian account, and Jira permissions are inherited from that account.
defaultPrompt: Find a Jira issue and summarize it.
Update a Jira issue after confirmation.
